notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
easyPrerequisites: Another Human has entered under your control this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Éowyn triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Breath of Fury
uses.cardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness
